company: Amazon.com, Inc. (AWS Lambda is a service of Amazon Web Services)

ownership.parent: Amazon.com, Inc. (via Amazon Web Services, Inc.)
ownership.quote: AWS Lambda (a serverless function that can perform arbitrary code written in any language that can be configured to be triggered by hundreds of events, including HTTP calls)

stage.note: AWS Lambda is a product line inside Amazon Web Services, a segment of Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN), a public company. No independent funding history applies.

revenue.basis: AWS segment net sales for full-year 2025, per Amazon.com's Q4 2025 earnings press release, as cited by Wikipedia's AWS infobox. Figure is for the entire AWS segment (all services, not AWS Lambda specifically); Lambda's own revenue is not separately disclosed.

note: AWS Lambda is not an independent company; it is a serverless-compute product within Amazon Web Services, which is a business segment of publicly traded Amazon.com, Inc. Funding/accelerator/ownership fields reflect this: no seed/Series rounds apply, and revenue given is for the whole AWS segment (launched 2006), not Lambda in isolation (Lambda itself launched 2014).
